questions.question: run-klippy.ps1 fails because its bare `dotnet build` builds the whole solution, and Klippy.Android fails here (Android SDK API 36 isn't installed). The desktop app itself builds and runs fine — I've launched it from this worktree. The startup hook says another agent (sdk-ts @ Atlantic1) is active on issue #53. How should I fix it?

options.label: Edit run-klippy.ps1 (Recommended)
options.description: Change it to `dotnet run --project ./Klippy.Desktop/Klippy.Desktop.csproj`, which builds only Desktop + Klippy. One-line change, commit on this branch.

options.label: Install Android API 36
options.description: Run `dotnet build -t:InstallAndroidDependencies` so the full solution builds. No repo change; large SDK download.

options.label: Leave it
options.description: The app is already running; no change.
